null_redundant.note: all behaviours constrain a single shared direction

tests_vs_random_null.note: small p means the observed directions are MORE aligned (share more structure) than random

interpretation: The behaviour-specific stiff directions are neither redundant nor randomly oriented. They span an effective 2.98 of 4 dimensions, significantly below the 3.50 expected for randomly oriented directions (p=0.0204) and far above the 1.0 of a single shared direction, so the growth of the union with repertoire size is not the trivial consequence of non-identical subspaces: the behaviours share substantial structure while each still contributes a distinct component.
